rubricScores.criterion: Identified that the signing target sweeps a distribution/output folder
Recognized that multiple projects write to the same output folder
Connected the access-denied error to file ownership or read-only constraints (such as CAS hard links in CloudBuild)
Explained why the failure is non-deterministic (depends on project build order / timing)
Suggested separating project outputs or removing redundant Distrib/Robocopy configurations from library projects

scenarios.scenario: Analysis — Diagnose why code signing fails with access denied
scenarios.reasoning: The agent performed a competent investigation of the binlog and correctly identified the two file locations and that only the shared output folder file fails. However, it arrived at the wrong root cause — attributing the failure to parallel build write lock contention rather than CloudBuild CAS hard links making files read-only. This is a significant diagnostic error that leads to fixes that wouldn't actually resolve the problem. The investigation methodology was reasonable (searching errors, examining tasks, looking at file lists), but the agent didn't dig deep enough into why files in the output directory would be access-denied specifically (read-only attributes, hard link characteristics) versus simply locked by another process.
